milestones.name: Identify game build and map functions
milestones.detail: GD 2.2091 pinned by exe hash; 31 function addresses verified against the exe

milestones.name: Isolated bridge into the game
milestones.detail: Mod controls GD tick by tick; save and network isolation verified byte-for-byte

milestones.name: Replay parity and throughput
milestones.detail: 60/60 parity checks with objects on; dedicated mode about 56x real time at k=4

milestones.name: First learning on drills
milestones.detail: Imitation from 9 demo runs clears 6.3/9 unseen drills (vs 2.7 for PPO); imitation is the default recipe now

milestones.name: Practice: checkpoints and start positions
milestones.detail: Practice from checkpoints plus re-cloning: 23/27 clean clears vs 19/27 without practice; triple spike still unsolved

milestones.name: Curriculum: drills to official levels
milestones.detail: All-mode drills verified; better collision features lift unseen drills to 22/27, but real levels stay at 2-13% (0/5 official, 0/10 online). Next: search-based teacher

milestones.name: Held-out evaluation and polish
milestones.detail: Frozen protocol on unseen levels; attempts-to-first-clear over time

milestones.name: Stretch goals
milestones.detail: Parallel game instances, cloud GPU, platformer mode
